title: The Episode About the Origin of the Khalsa

blocks.text: They did not describe Nadir Shah fully, nor how he plundered Delhi and slaughtered its people.
They did not tell how the Singhs also harried and robbed him on his return toward Kandahar and Kabul. (24)
Then Ahmad Shah Abdali occupied Lahore and seized the whole tract from Delhi to Agra.
Yet the Singhs drove him out and slew many of his forces. (25)
So the Khalsa Panth had long been engaged in struggle, while the wicked emperors falsely called them mere subjects. (26–27)
The wicked do not abandon wickedness, just as a serpent does not abandon its poison. (28)
